definitions.explanation: Yoga practiced in a room heated to around 35–40°C and kept at high humidity, intended to promote flexibility and sweating. Widely offered as a class-based studio service in Japan.

examples.japanese: ホットヨガを{始|はじ}めた。
ホットヨガで{大量|たいりょう}に{汗|あせ}をかいた。
examples.english: I sweated heavily doing hot yoga.

examples.japanese: {冷|ひ}え{性|しょう}{対策|たいさく}にホットヨガに{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I attend hot yoga to deal with my poor circulation.

notes:
Loanword. Commonly marketed in Japan for {冷|ひ}え{性|しょう} (sensitivity to cold) and {美容|びよう} (beauty/skin care) benefits as much as for fitness.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ホットヨガスタジオ: hot yoga studio
- ホットヨガに{通|かよ}う: to attend hot yoga
- ホットヨガのレッスン: hot yoga lesson

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ヨガ: yoga — the general term; not heated
- ピラティス: Pilates — different exercise system, not heated
